models._comment_units: All rates are USD per 1,000 tokens (per-1K). lib/costs.sh computes cost as (token_count / 1000) * rate, so every value here MUST be a per-1K rate = (provider $/1M price) / 1000. Do NOT paste $/MTok figures directly.
models._comment_scope: Current models only (5.5.0). Superseded models are listed in retired_models with their replacement; configure migrates them and the runtime warns. A model absent from this table is reported as unpriced, never priced at a guessed rate. Rates are official list prices, Verified 2026-10-24.

claude-fable-5-1.notes: Standard API list rate ($10/$50 per 1M). Cache/service adjustments excluded. Verified 2026-10-24.

claude-opus-5-5.notes: Standard API list rate ($4/$20 per 1M); 1M context at standard pricing. Cache/service adjustments excluded. Verified 2026-10-24.

claude-haiku-5-5.notes: Standard API list rate ($0.10/$0.50 per 1M) for prompts up to 100K tokens; over 100K the whole request bills at $0.50/$2.50 (5x). Verified 2026-10-24.

gemini-4-argon.notes: List rate from 2026-12-01 ($4/$20 per 1M); the introductory $2/$10 through 2026-11-30 is not applied, so budgets fail safe. Thinking tokens bill as output; cache discounts excluded. Verified 2026-10-24.

models._comment_agy: Antigravity CLI (agy) addresses Gemini models by display name and runs on subscription auth; these rates mirror the matching Gemini API model so the estimator stays consistent.

gemini-3.8-flash.notes: Promotional rate through 2026-12-31 ($0.75/$3.75 per 1M); standard from 2027-01-01: $1.50/$7.50. Cache/service adjustments excluded. Verified 2026-10-24.

Gemini 3.8 Flash (High).notes: Promotional API-equivalent estimate through 2026-12-31; standard from 2027-01-01: 0.0015/0.0075 per 1K. Cache/service adjustments excluded; not a CLI invoice.

Gemini 3.8 Flash (Medium).notes: Promotional API-equivalent estimate through 2026-12-31; standard from 2027-01-01: 0.0015/0.0075 per 1K. Cache/service adjustments excluded; not a CLI invoice.

Gemini 3.8 Flash (Low).notes: Promotional API-equivalent estimate through 2026-12-31; standard from 2027-01-01: 0.0015/0.0075 per 1K. Cache/service adjustments excluded; not a CLI invoice.

gpt-6-astra.notes: Standard rate ($10/$50 per 1M). >272K input: long-context rates for the full request (2x input, 1.5x output). Cache/service adjustments excluded. Verified 2026-10-24.

gpt-6.1-sol.notes: Standard rate ($2/$10 per 1M). >272K input: long-context rates for the full request (2x input, 1.5x output). Cache/service adjustments excluded. Verified 2026-10-24.

mistral-large-4.notes: Public preview; list rate ($1.36/$4.18 per 1M). Alias of mistral-large-4-0. Verified 2026-10-24.

mistral-medium-3.5.notes: Medium 3.5 ($1.50/$7.50 per 1M); Vibe CLI name. Verified 2026-10-24.

mistral-small-2603.notes: Mistral Small 4 ($0.15/$0.60 per 1M); API opt-in. Verified 2026-10-24.

deepseek-flash.notes: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. Peak cache-miss rate ($0.30/$1.20 per 1M); off-peak (50%) and cache-hit discounts excluded. Verified 2026-10-24.

grok-4.7.notes: Standard rate ($2/$6 per 1M); at 200K input or more both rates double for the request. Cache, regional, priority and Fast rates excluded. Verified 2026-10-24.

models._comment_unpriced: Subscription-billed transports: these consultants run on a plan that bills by quota (Kimi Code, Qwen Token Plan, GLM coding-plan endpoint), not per token. Rated 0 and listed in unpriced_models, so the session report discloses the exclusion instead of implying the model was free. For reference, the pay-as-you-go API prices per 1M are: kimi-k3.1-pro $2/$10, qwen3.8-max $2/$6, qwen3.8-flash $0.15/$0.47, GLM-5.3 $1.40/$4.40, GLM-5.3-Flash $0.15/$0.50 (Verified 2026-10-24.)

muse-wonder-1.0.notes: Standard mode rate ($4.00/$20.00 per 1M; cached input $0.20 excluded). No long-context premium. Preview; no Contributor mode on the API. Verified 2026-10-24.

muse-spark-1.3.notes: Standard mode rate ($1.25/$4.25 per 1M; cached input $0.15 excluded). No long-context premium. Verified 2026-10-24.

muse-spark-1.3-contributor.notes: Contributor mode rate ($0.10/$0.20 per 1M): Meta may train on prompts, context and responses. Opt-in by pinning only. Verified 2026-10-24.

retired_models._comment: Superseded models (removed in 5.5.0) -> current replacement. configure migrates a persisted value, pinned or not, and records migrated-from; the runtime warns when one is still selected. null: the consultant itself was removed.

model_tiers._comment: Model tiers for apply_model_tier() (mirrors get_model_for_tier in scripts/config.sh)

transport_model_tiers._comment: Transport-specific namespaces used by Gemini and Mistral; the legacy model_tiers table reflects their CLI values.
